verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to automate, customize, and execute software development workflows right in your repository (github-docs-38), and GitHub markets it as CI/CD (github-docs-11). Community comments treat Actions as GitHub's CI/CD offering, citing its included minutes and comparing it with GitLab CI/CD (github-comm-16, github-comm-19, github-comm-5). missing for 10: explicit documentation of the workflow-as-code file format, explicit evidence of automatic triggers on pushes and pull requests, hands-on corroboration of pipeline runs.
